name: EasyEDA Pro MCP (Experimental)
description: MCP tool surface for EasyEDA Pro (嘉立创EDA专业版). Serves a small fixed tool set plus a searchable catalog of eda.* API calls, bridged to the EDA connector extension over WebSocket.
author: Vibe Terminal

config_fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
config_fields.description: Per-request timeout in seconds applied to every bridge request sent to the EDA connector. Increase it for slow EDA operations.
